chapterTitle: Chapter 11 Reactions of Alkyl Halides: Nucleophilic Substitutions and Eliminations
title: Problem 11-12

pages.text: PROBLEM 11-12 3-Bromo-1-butene and 1-bromo-2-butene undergo SN1 reaction at nearly the same rate, even though one is a secondary halide and the other is primary. Explain.
